title: ci: speed up pull request checks
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
Model PRs spent 6–7 min in one serial job, and ~70% of that was two vitest suites whose time was mostly not tests.

- Apply D1 test migrations once per run instead of importing `cloudflare:test` on every setup-file execution. That import loads the Worker main module, which vitest-pool-workers re-evaluates after every test file: 102s of "setup" in gen (115 files) and 23s in enter (56 files). On this PR's run: gen setup 4s, enter setup 3s.
- Fix the `seedreamModel` mock, which lacked `toDataUri` and only passed because the preloaded module graph made the mock ineffective.
- Split lint, enter tests, and gen tests into parallel jobs. A `gate` job keeps the `Check formatting and linting` name the main ruleset requires, so no ruleset change is needed.
- Checkout with `fetch-depth: 2` and diff `HEAD^1 HEAD` (the merge commit's first parent is the base tip) instead of fetching the full 2 GB history: 36–44s → 3s.
- Cache `node_modules` keyed on the lockfile plus every workspace `package.json`, so `npm ci` (35s) is skipped on a hit but still runs, and reports drift, whenever a manifest changes.
- enter `pretest` builds sdk+ui only; an empty `dist/client` satisfies wrangler's assets check. The lint job builds the enter frontend (change-filtered, in parallel with the test jobs) so bundling is still verified on pull requests.

Measured on this PR (cold node_modules cache): 3m21s total, was 6–7 min. Gen test step 150s → 91s, enter 149s → 134s. Enter is now the long pole and its remaining time is real test work (96s of tests across 56 files).

gist.headline: The checks found a shortcut
gist.blurb: Pull request checks stopped hauling the entire garden shed uphill. Migrations now bloom once, jobs run side by side, and the hive gets results in about half the time.
gist.summary: Pull request CI now applies D1 migrations once per test run, parallelizes lint plus enter/gen test jobs, uses shallow two-commit diffs, and caches node_modules by lockfile and workspace manifests, cutting cold-cache checks from 6–7 minutes to 3m21s.
gist.impact: Contributors get substantially faster PR feedback while retaining migration coverage, frontend build verification, and manifest-drift detection.
